name: Bhagavad Gita 10.9
text:
मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम् ।
कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च ॥
meaning: With their minds and lives given to me, enlightening one another and always speaking of me, they are content and delighted.
purpose: Shared reflection and conversation as sources of joy and devotion.
supports: Contemplation; carrying one idea through the day.
when: Read slowly, once or a few times, and sit with it.
